instruction: Name the artist most recommended to me on Spotify.
notes: Fix: the predicate formerly named artist-name collided with the type artist-name; it is renamed to artist-named. Read-only question task: no database changes, only information gathering. The recommendation list is abstracted as one representative song object (recommended-song); at runtime the agent paginates spotify.show_recommendations and calls spotify.show_song for every recommended song, counting artist ids. The STRIPS model cannot count, so the aggregation is folded into spotify-show-song, whose effect asserts (found-most-recommended ?ar) for the artist of the recommended song(s); the static init facts (artist-of ...) and (artist-named ...) encode world structure unknown to the agent until the corresponding lookup action runs. Login username is the supervisor's email obtained from supervisor.show_profile (profile-known). supervisor-complete-task takes the artist name as its answer parameter and is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every action; the goal requires the answer to be known and answered.
